verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents capping employees' spend with card controls and custom limits, adjusting spend limits instantly, and embedding expense policies into the card program. Its MCP docs also confirm per-card updates to spending limits and reset intervals, and departmental budgets and employee permissions add further control. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of what the granular controls include (e.g. merchant/category restrictions, per-employee policy rules), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing.
